items.text: in its current state 2/17/2025, its a pretty ,yet occasionally buggy game. With an extremely high learning curve ( I could Just be Stupid ), its has plenty of content if ur able to learn the game and ok with its UI. I would only really recommend if ur have lots of time or are Really desperate for a Space game.
items.text_zh: 在2025年2月17日的当前状态下，它是一款挺漂亮但偶尔有bug的游戏。学习曲线极其陡峭（也可能只是我太蠢了），如果你能学会这款游戏并且能接受它的UI，那它内容很丰富。我真的只推荐给有大量时间的人，或者非常渴望一款太空游戏的人。

observations.description: UI存在问题，需要玩家能够接受
